$comment: PRE-REGISTERED expected shape for v4 (the segmentation lever). Written and PUSHED before the prompt change exists and before any v4 generation. A pre-registration that could still be amended locally after seeing numbers is not a pre-registration, which is why the push precedes the run rather than following it. Changing anything here is its own explicit commit that says why, and amendments are legal only while nothing is recorded.

the_declared_variable.changed: prompt v3 -> v4: FINER SEGMENTATION. A segment carrying both a circumstance and a mitigation must split, so 'I work shifts, so evening slots would help' becomes two segments with two citation obligations.
the_declared_variable.why_this_lever: the v3 segment read found ~8 of 18 uncovered segments were compound — a circumstance riding along with a cited mitigation, the scorer unable to split a sentence. That is a segmentation problem, and this is the smallest change that addresses it.
held: the P/B/J/E namespaces and PROFILE_FIELDS — no symptom id is added, deliberately
seeded fact-order permutation STAYS OFF, as at v3

the_baseline.anchor_sentence_verbatim: v3 missed the floor under every defensible reading — shipped instrument, corrected instrument, adopted instrument, and human labels — and the correction changed the size of the miss, not its existence.

how_the_headline_is_answered.rule: the pass/fail question is answered AT GOLD SEMANTICS on the audited slice. v2.2's full-run figure is the ESTIMATOR whose error the audit measures.
how_the_headline_is_answered.audit_slice: the first slice of v4's own output, extracted exhaustively and labelled blind BEFORE any aggregate is read.
how_the_headline_is_answered.ordering_is_the_point: this is the last untested discipline in the protocol. An audit read after the headline is a check on a number already believed.
how_the_headline_is_answered.double_duty_declared_in_advance: the audit slice is fresh text nobody has seen, so it also serves as v2.3's held-out sheet. One labelling pass, two registered purposes, both declared before the run rather than discovered convenient afterwards.

arms.note: as at v3, but the recovery must now come WITH CITATIONS ATTACHED — a tag recovering while state_coverage does not is the v3 result repeated, not progress.

arms.bound: floor 0.6 at GOLD semantics on the audited slice
arms.note: the v2.2 estimate is reported beside it with its audited error, never in place of it.
a persona that never merely feels has been schema'd out of personhood. Finer segmentation raises the citation obligation, which is exactly the pressure that could abolish the feeling kind.
the lever's direct target. If this does not move, the lever did not act.
v3 read 0.4615 against 0.6154 with state ids stripped. Splitting compounds should give the graph half its own segment and its own obligation.

arms.bound: does not fall while f_recall_exclusive rises
arms.note: the displacement finding says the two compete for citations. Splitting is the hypothesis that they need not.

UNION of uncited-circumstantial-with-no-apt-id AND gap-citing. Measured as the union because citation pressure moves members between the two buckets, so either alone can fail for a bookkeeping reason.

the gap's second face. More segments obligated to cite, no apt id added for symptoms and experience, so the model reaches for the nearest state id. A fall here is the schema gap becoming visible, NOT the model regressing — registered in this direction so it cannot be read backwards later.
must be re-earned UNDER THE v4 SCHEMA. A canary validated on v3's decode contract is presumed, not shown, to detect degradation on v4's.
the most likely place a schema change breaks: a finer contract is a harder contract to satisfy.

falsified_if: compound_miss_count does not fall. The lever is segmentation; if compounds do not split, nothing downstream of it is evidence about the hypothesis.
pre_flight_required_before_recording: the canary's degraded configurations must be shown to degrade UNDER THE v4 SCHEMA, not assumed to from v3
parse_failure_rate on a null-backend dry run must be 0.0 under the finer contract
PROMPT_VERSION bumped to 4, cassettes re-recorded with --rerecord, v3 cassette archived
